title: Combat prose that states HP the engine recorded
description: A hit that leaves the bandit with 3 HP. Any HP figure in prose must equal the engine's recorded value; the summary's roll line must survive.
player_input: I swing at the bandit with my longsword.

play.consequence_planner.mechanical_summary: Lyra swings at the bandit (d20 rolled 16 + 5 = 21 vs AC 12 -> success). The hit deals 7 damage; the bandit is left with 3 HP.

scripted.play.narrator: Your longsword opens the bandit's shoulder. He staggers back with blood on his sleeve, with 3 HP left and his guard clearly broken. He is still on his feet. What do you do next?
